sections.Profile:
Screech, produced by Inder in 1976, is a pinball machine that exists in two versions: a single-player electro-mechanical (EM) model and a four-player solid-state (SS) model. Both versions feature two flippers, three pop bumpers, and dual inlanes on the left and right sides

- Manufacturer: Inder
- Years made: 1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Women, Original Theme, 1970s
